title: WorkstreamMarker
description: Closed v1 marker contract for the Workstream Registration corpus (U1, PLAN:354-365). The marker is the durable, assistant-neutral self-description written at .workstream/manifest.json (2026-08-07 operator decision, digest 2026080702; KTD2, PLAN:187; R10). A reader dispatches on the required integer `version` before applying this closed schema (KTD3, PLAN:188); v1 allows the value 1. Closed fields freeze at U1 (PLAN:554): identity is an RFC 4122 v4 lowercase UUID, label is required and non-empty with a 256-byte cap, kind is required (direct|proxy), the workspace reference is the literal `.` (KTD4, PLAN:189), and record_sources is a required non-empty list of 1-32 bounded typed absolute URI references (KTD5, PLAN:190). Field limits per PLAN:362: 256-byte label, 64-char ASCII type token, 2,048-char ASCII URI (the 2,048-byte budget, PLAN:167). Any syntactically well-formed URI is accepted regardless of scheme or credential-bearing content; no credential fields exist; malformed URIs warn without invalidating the marker (capability of a later unit, PLAN:362). The 256 KiB raw-byte cap, depth 8, duplicate-name, non-finite, and control rejections are raw-guard obligations (KTD11, PLAN:196), not schema keywords.

version.description: Marker contract version; readers dispatch on it before applying the closed schema (KTD3, PLAN:188). v1 allowed value: 1 (PLAN:554).

identity.description: Arjim-generated permanent workstream identity (KD3, PLAN:64); RFC 4122 v4 UUID, lowercase (PLAN:554). Never regenerated (R14, PLAN:118).

label.description: Mutable operator-facing name; a label is data, not an instruction (KTD9, PLAN:194). Required, non-empty (pattern excludes empty and whitespace-only strings), 256-byte cap enforced via maxLength (PLAN:554, 362).

kind.description: direct = regular workspace where the workstream actually lives; proxy = proxy workspace holding the marker for a workstream whose real location cannot store assistant metadata (R6-R7, PLAN:101-102; terminology settled 2026-08-04, PLAN:547).

workspace.description: Literal workspace self-reference; device paths and traversal are invalid (KTD4, PLAN:189; PLAN:362).

record_sources.description: Required non-empty list of 1-32 typed absolute URI references (PLAN:362, 554); duplicate record sources are invalid (PLAN:364).

type.description: Namespaced type token, ASCII, at most 64 characters (PLAN:362). Open data; capability is reported separately (PLAN:307).

uri.description: Absolute URI reference, RFC 3986 ASCII; non-ASCII content must be percent-encoded, so the 2,048-character limit is also a 2,048-byte budget (PLAN:167, 190, 362). Any syntactically well-formed URI is accepted regardless of scheme or credential-bearing content (KTD5, PLAN:190); untrusted data that is never dereferenced or inspected (PLAN:168).
